title: Collaboration Workspace Access Troubleshooting Guide
content: Synthetic collaboration-platform support guide for Example Manufacturing. For a user who can sign in to the collaboration platform but cannot access an expected workspace after a team or role transfer: IT Support may verify workspace membership status and role-synchronization status without changing access. Ask the user to fully sign out, close the browser session, and sign in again with current corporate credentials. If access remains unavailable after these checks, escalate to Enterprise Applications Support for an authorized membership review. This guide does not authorize changing workspace membership, roles, privileges, or team records. Korean support phrasing: 팀 이동 후 협업 플랫폼 로그인은 되지만 새 팀 워크스페이스에 접근할 수 없습니다.
